usedFor: Box holds files and Asana holds work, so “New File” can open a task with “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New File” in Box, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A new file often needs someone to review it, and the action sets assignee, dates and description on the task.

watchOut: “New File” in Box is polling, so the Asana task appears after a scheduled check, not instantly.
